status_definitions.REJECTED_STALE_OR_UNSAFE: Conflicts with current architecture/evidence controls or contains unsafe/uncontrolled claims; not to be used as production input.

status_definitions.ARCHIVE_LINEAGE_ONLY: Historical/generated/duplicate material useful only for lineage or regression comparison.
status_definitions.IDENTICAL_ASSET_NO_ACTION: Asset matches current production asset; no action required.
status_definitions.ARCHIVE_CONTROL: Instruction/control that belongs only to the archive folder.
